Hadith.3817 - Zurara narrated: "I said to Abu Abdullah (as): A man buys a slave along with his wealth.
Imam (as) replied: 'There is no harm in it.'
I asked: 'What if the wealth of the slave is greater than the price he was purchased for?'
Imam (as) replied: 'There is no harm in it.'
